rules.title: Storage accounts carry a data-classification tag
rules.description: WAF Security (SE:03 data classification) & APRL storage guidance: data-at-rest stores should be labelled with a data-classification tag so protection controls can be applied per sensitivity.

rules.title: Key Vaults declare a security owner
rules.description: WAF Security (SE:04 segmentation & ownership): secret stores should name an accountable security owner so access reviews and incident response have a clear contact.

rules.title: Public IPs are tagged with an exposure justification
rules.description: WAF Security (SE:06 network controls) & WARA reliability/security review: internet-exposed public IPs should carry a documented exposure-justification tag; untagged public exposure is surfaced fail-closed for review.
